identity.title: MIRACLE SUMMER: Challenging the Pokémon Trading Card Game World Championships

leadText:
----
 
MIRACLE SUMMER: Challenging the Pokémon Trading Card Game World Championships (Japanese: MIRACLE SUMMER: Challenging the , Chinese: Summer of Chasing Dreams: Challenging the ) is an hour-long live-action documentary that was released on YouTube in Japanese and on Bilibili in Chinese on December 6, 2024, and on YouTube with Japanese subtitles on December 29, 2024. It was announced with a trailer that was released on YouTube and X (formerly Twitter) in Japanese and on Bilibili, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin in Chinese on November 29, 2024.

It was announced with a trailer that was released on YouTube and X (formerly Twitter) in Japanese and on Bilibili, Weibo, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin in Chinese on November 29, 2024.

==Logos==
 
MIRACLE SUMMER Chinese logo.png|Chinese logo
 

==Plot==
 
The documentary tells the story of Nii., a player of the Simplified Chinese version of the Pokémon Trading Card Game, in reaching the 2024 Pokémon World Championships in August 2024.
